description: Free; no account, payment or Gravitate credits. Use only with explicitly supplied 1–4 ranks for craft, face visibility/expression, pose, setting and signal, after reading the methodology. Calculates gravitate-v1 totals and caps for 1–6 anonymous observations. Accepts no images/URLs; performs no vision or AI inference. Does not measure beauty, age, identity, attraction percentiles or match probability. Never invent ranks from a request without observations.

observation_source.description: Who assigned these ranks. Assistant observations are the calling assistant's judgment, not Gravitate image analysis.

label.description: An anonymous label A–F, never a name, URL or identifier.

ranks.description: Use the published rubric: 1 poor, 2 usable, 3 good, 4 excellent. Rank face visibility/expression, never facial beauty.

subject_present.description: Whether the profile owner is visible; false caps the score at 25.

visual_defect.description: A clearly visible rendering/artifact defect; true caps the score at 60.

name: score_photo_observations
title: Calculate photo-presentation scores
